content:
While iOS 27's launch has stolen the spotlight, Apple also rolled out a new software update for AirPods this month. This update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom EQ.

AirPods software details

The latest AirPods firmware version numbers are 9A350 (AirPods 5) and 9A348 (all other older models). This update applies to the following AirPods models:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)
  • AirPods 5
  • AirPods 5 (with Wireless Charging Case)
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C)
  • AirPods Max 2

Apple says the AirPods firmware update installs automatically when your AirPods are charging and within Bluetooth range of an iPhone, iPad, or Mac connected to Wi-Fi. You can also check your AirPods firmware version in the Settings app on your iPhone.

Custom EQ feature lands on AirPods

After installing the AirPods firmware update, you'll find the long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: custom EQ.

Thanks to the new custom EQ controls, you can now fine-tune your AirPods' sound output more independently. You can adjust the bass, mids, and treble of your AirPods audio in the Settings app.

Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce the audio of music, TV shows, and movies, as well as call quality. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customise the tone of your AirPods for any audio."

While adjusting custom EQ settings, you can play songs from Apple Music directly in the Settings app to hear the effects of your adjustments in real time.

This isn't the most advanced EQ on the market — just a basic three-band system. But for AirPods users, it's been a long time coming, and Apple has finally given them this option — even though most people will likely stick with the default settings.

You can find the new custom EQ feature under the "Audio & Path" menu in the AirPods section of the Settings app. This feature applies to all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other AirPods features in iOS 27

Here are the other new AirPods features in iOS 27:

  • Redesigned Settings app: In iOS 27, Apple has redesigned the AirPods interface within the Settings app. Controls have been reorganised, splitting features like hearing health, Find My, and Live Translation into separate menus.
  • Adaptive Audio slider: You can now use a slider in the Settings app to further fine-tune Adaptive Audio mode.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been available for years, it has always required an Apple Watch. As my colleague Zac reported, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can now use the Precision Finding feature in the Find My app on your Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • Siri AI: When used with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Wrap-up

Which new AirPods feature are you most eager to try? Will you experiment with the new custom EQ? Let us know in the comments.
